The former", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "meaning is quite appropriate. Comp. Vikramorvashî opening", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "Stanza and Raghuvans'a VIII., 19. The last line may be thus", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "rendered “we have performed exactly those various actions", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "which are performed by the sages, but we have not obtained", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "their various fruits.” Râmarshi renders वञ्चिताः by रहिताः add-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 8, "text": "ing तत्तपःफलम् न अलभामहि. Rightly; compare Naishadha I., 127", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "and Raghu VII., 8 with Mallinâtha’s comment. This Stanza oc-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 10, "text": "curs also at p. 302 of the Kâvyasangraha.—S'ârdûlavikrîḍita.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XIV.—तृष्णा तरुणायते. Comp. St. 12 and Mohamudgara St.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "15. (Kâvyasangraha p. 33).—Anushṭub.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XV.—अम्बर = either sky or cloth. There is an equivoque", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "here. दौर्गत्य comp. दुर्गत. Nîtis'ataka St. 56.—Anushṭub.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r6", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XVI.—वियोग seems to answer to स्वयं त्यक्ता in the fourth", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "line meaning voluntary separation. The commentary introduces", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "the third line thus ननु गमनशीलत्वात्स्वयमेव यास्यन्ति को लाभस्तत्त्यागे इत्याश-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 4, "text": "ङ्क्याह ॥ अतुलपरितापाय. For the dative see Siddh. Kaum. I., 280. For", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "the last line comp. Gîtâ chap. II., 70 et seq. The Stanza occurs", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "at p. 311 of the Kâvyasangraha.—S'ikhariṇî.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r7", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XVII.—व्याकोश is given by Amara as a synonyme of प्रफुल्ल,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "विकच, &c. The first line may then be thus translated : “Desire is", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "allayed when self-restraint developed by means of true discrimina-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 4, "text": "tion opens up [in a man].” शम is said in the Vedântasâra to mean", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "श्रवणादि (i. e. श्रवणमनननिदिध्यासन) व्यतिरिक्तविषयेभ्यो मनसो निग्रहः. परिष्बङ्ग =", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "contact with objects of sense (स्रक्चन्दनवनितादि as the Vedântins", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "say) परिणति = result, end. The third line is not quite clear. It", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "seems to mean “wretched by reason of the strong distraction of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "the enjoyment of greatness old through age”. यस्याम् of course is", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "correlative to सा.—S'ikhariṇî.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "40", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r2", "type": "running_header", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "NOTES.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "notes", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": true, "children": ["u2", "u3", "u4", "u5", "u6"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "stanza_note", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "14", "label": "St. XIV.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r4"]}, {"id": "u4", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "15", "label": "St. XV.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r5"]}, {"id": "u5", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "16", "label": "St. XVI.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r6"]}, {"id": "u6", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "17", "label": "St. XVII.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r7"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
